title: About this Wiki
text:
About us

    MKReyesH



Powered By

GitHub Pages: Hosting and deployment infrastructure.
Quarto: Markdown rendering, cross-referencing, and website generation.
Pandoc: Document format translation.
Bootstrap and Bootswatch: CSS support and user interface.
MathJax: Mathematical notation rendering.
Gemini: Help writing the Lua filters.



Contributing
If you would like to contribute to the core template, add new LaTeX translation rules, or fix a bug, do not hesitate to open a Pull Request at the GitHub Repository.

[3] Gotz D, Laurent P, Antier S, Covino S, D’Avanzo P, D’Elia V and Melandri A 2014 GRB 140206A: the most distant polarized Gamma-Ray Burst Mon. Not. Roy. Astron. Soc. 444 2776–82


[4] Wei J-J, Wu X-F, Gao H and Mészáros P 2016 Limits on the Neutrino Velocity, Lorentz Invariance, and the Weak Equivalence Principle with TeV Neutrinos from Gamma-Ray Bursts JCAP 08 031

[8] Chen L, Xiong Z, Li C, Chen S and He H 2021 Strong constraints on Lorentz violation using new \(\gamma\)-ray observations around PeV Chin. Phys. C 45 105105


[9] Maccione L, Liberati S and Mattingly D M 2013 Violations of Lorentz invariance in the neutrino sector after OPERA JCAP 03 039
